run_evaluate_masks: run evaluate_masks to evaluate instance segmentation results on the Cityscapes dataset using predicted boxes and segmentations
review_evaluate_masks: review evaluate_masks function that decodes RLE masks, writes prediction text files, and saves mask PNGs for Cityscapes evaluation
test_evaluate_masks: test evaluate_masks by providing a json_dataset, all_boxes, all_segms, and output_dir to generate Cityscapes evaluation results
refactor_evaluate_masks: refactor evaluate_masks to support additional Cityscapes evaluation metrics or alternative output formats beyond the default txt and png
summarize_evaluate_masks: summarize evaluate_masks which iterates over a roidb, decodes segmentation masks, writes prediction files, and invokes the Cityscapes evaluation script
